wordLimitAudit.scope: Cumulative event narrative: titles, summaries, paragraphs, anecdotes, cautions and date notes. Date/place labels and bibliographic metadata excluded. wordLimitAudit.counting: Whitespace-delimited words; paragraph sentences split after ., ! or ? followed by whitespace. Distinct references are grouped by exact URL.
